summary.text: Robert Nichols, a Republican businessman from Jacksonville, Texas, represents Texas Senate District 3 and has served in the Senate since 2007. He chairs the Senate Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Nichols earned a bachelor's degree in industrial engineering from Lamar University in 1968.
In Jacksonville he served on the city council and as mayor, built four manufacturing facilities and earned 32 U.S. patents.
Before running for the Senate he served for eight years as a transportation commissioner.
His district includes 18 counties in East and Southeast Texas.
